name: 26554 · Fairmont, WV
findings: ZIP 26554 (Fairmont) has 164 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 26554 (Fairmont) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 26554 (Fairmont) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
